messages:
Nina Park: Opening a tiny docs PR to cover an installer edge case: when customers deploy Private in an isolated rack and use HSM-backed KMS with split DNS. Need: a short network diagram sentence, example CoreDNS conditional forward, HSM hostname example, and two quick validation commands. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1317 :mag:

build-bot: PR created by Nina Park: redwood-inference/docs #1317 - `private: split-dns + hsm hostname examples` (CI started)

Diego Ramos: For the HSM note, call out that PKCS11 endpoints are resolved via kms.hsm.internal and that customers must ensure the forwarder returns the HSM IP and not an external CDN. Small CoreDNS block would help.

Claire Holt: Add a one-liner about firewall ports: allow 443/8443 to KMS control plane, 1792/1793 (example) to HSM appliance if using vendor RPC, and DNS (53/853) as needed. Keep it advisory since vendors differ.

Diego Ramos: Also include a migration tip for folks who previously used static host entries: undo the hosts, restart resolver, then validate HSM connectivity. Mention `systemd-resolved` capture quirk on Ubuntu.

Nina Park: Pasting compact CoreDNS snippet and two smoke tests to paste into PR. Feedback welcome.

Nina Park: ```
.:1053 {
    forward kms.hsm.internal 10.200.5.10 10.200.5.11
    forward . 1.1.1.1 tls_servername=dot.upstream.example
    cache { success 600 denial 20 }
    log
}
```

Nina Park: Smoke tests:
`dig +short @127.0.0.1 -p 1053 kms.hsm.internal A`
`openssl s_client -connect 10.200.5.10:1792 -servername kms.hsm.internal`

Claire Holt: For clarity add a short sentence: "If customers see TLS hostname mismatches when connecting to HSM, verify the resolved IP points to the managed appliance inside their VPC."

Diego Ramos: Small wording: prefer `Private (VPC/on-prem)` in public docs. Also recommend denial cache = 20s for HSM names to avoid long NXDOMAIN.

build-bot: CI passed for #1317 - linkcheck and linter OK.

Nina Park: Merged after minor edits. I'll add a release-note blurb and reference to the installer flag `--resolver-mode=stub` in the changelog. Thanks!
